simple.summary: אֶלְעוּזַי (ʼElʻûwzay) means Eluzai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 6.

definitions.full: H498. Eluzay אֶלְעוּזַי proper name, masculine ( God is my strength = אֶלְעֻזּי , compare עֻזּיאֵל , Sabean אלעךת ( אלעז ) DHM ZMG 1883, 15 ) one of the heroes of David 1Chr 12:5 .
definitions.rootNote: from 410 and 5756 (in the sense of 5797 ); God (is) defensive;
